review.reviewer: Volta and McClintock read-only campaign reviewers
findings: Volta approved all seven replacements as valid single-fault candidates.
McClintock conditionally approved the set, requiring C04-v2 and E04-v2 to retain only one stale GROUP BY consumer and requiring F01-v2 to update its mutation anchor for SELECT 1.

Those conditions are resolved in revision 3 by aggregate-only C04-v2/E04-v2 outer queries and the exact SELECT 1 F01-v2 mutation anchor. Both reviewers approved the 48-case, 39-invalid/9-valid totals.

sourceJustification.revision2Observation: The complete v2 audit found MQ3012 plus the expected MQ3001 or MQ3015 because a renamed nonaggregate projection or output was also required by the stale GROUP BY consumer.
sourceJustification.correction: Revision 3 uses aggregate-only projections for the grouped CTE/reference/derived cases, leaving exactly one stale GROUP BY consumer after the declaration or exported-output rename.
sourceJustification.reason: The correction isolates the declared visibility fault without deleting the relevant query-block boundary or adding an unrelated nonaggregate grouping condition. The resulting seed remains valid and the expected one-error contract is truthful.

authority.passage: Exported names and aliases are visible only in their declared query block; a stale grouped consumer must resolve against the current visible output without an independent nonaggregate projection fault.

sourceJustification.revision2Observation: The v2 audit showed MQ2001_UnexpectedToken before mutation because the nested EXISTS seed projected b.City in a grammar context requiring the scalar existence form.
sourceJustification.correction: Revision 3 uses SELECT 1 in the nested EXISTS seed. F01-v2 changes only the inner alias declaration while retaining stale b.Country; F02-v2 changes only the outer alias declaration while retaining the correlated inner a.Country.
sourceJustification.reason: The corrected seed is a valid correlated EXISTS baseline; each mutation retains exactly one stale alias in its intended nested scope and expects MQ3015_UnknownAlias.

authority.passage: Nested query blocks may shadow same-spelled aliases while retaining explicitly correlated outer aliases; stale aliases are diagnosed in the failing block.

sourceJustification.revision2Observation: The v2 audit showed the G01 seed itself emitted MQ3001 because it already selected the non-exported source-qualified name [a.City], so no valid baseline existed.
sourceJustification.correction: Revision 3 uses a valid CTE consumer selecting City and mutates only that outer consumer to [a.City].
sourceJustification.reason: The mutation now isolates the source-qualified export boundary while preserving the original CTE declaration and a valid seed.

authority.passage: A CTE exports its simple projection name unless a dotted output is explicitly declared; source qualifiers from the inner block are not implicitly exported.

fixtureCorrections: Removed the temporary all-candidate observation and G01 envelope audit methods after preserving their TRX evidence.
Replaced the seven v2 candidate constructions with the reviewed v3 versions; no production source was changed.
